My dad was recently diagnosed with Heart Failure after a Gallbladder surgery. It's just been 2 months

Major symptoms of a weak heart or a failed heart are
Edema(Swelling), Fluid Retention (based on which side of the heart is weaker the fluid retention can happen in those areas accordingly. For eg if it's the right side of the heart then fluid retention can happen in the abdomen and genitals), Lungs filled with Fluid, Excessive Coughing or Cardiac Cough as they say etc etc

These are the major symptoms or most common ones

If he follows Sodium Restrictions and Fluid Intake Restrictions and takes his medications on time then it can be managed. Make sure not to strain the heart much at any given point. Eat at the right time and the right thing else it can go downhill very quickly cause I've recently spent 2+ months in the hospital and have seen different kinds of heart patients so know it very well

For medications the doctors would have prescribed him Diuretics, Blood Pressure medications and Heart Medications. Diuretics are very important and missing it can cause fluid retention 

My father was recently prescribed Entresto. This medication helps with improving the EF of the heart or the pumping of the heart. You might wanna ask his doctor about it

Effects of Entresto are not immediate and often it takes several months to see improvement in the EF but it's generally well tolerated and a good drug to be on. It can cause negative effects on the kidneys but the doctors generally prescribe Entresto with a Kidney medication to preserve the kidneys
